description: gamma-CsPbI3 2x2x2 V_I fixed-path (MACE-relaxed CI-NEB band) DFT single-point profile
method: QE 7.5 PBE, US pslibrary-1.0.0 scalar-rel, ecutwfc 50 / ecutrho 400 Ry, Gamma, gauss 0.01 Ry
treatment: non-spin (nspin=1) for the 7-point profile; spin scan (nspin=2) done separately at img0/img3
notes: imgs 1,5,6 sit below img0; the NEB endpoints (0,6) are metastable but not the deepest points on the MACE path. img3 is the saddle (highest point) for BOTH charge states — confirms the benchmark barrier was not missing a hidden maximum.
